title: ChatGPT
description:
OpenAI's flagship conversational AI for writing, coding, and analysis.
Available in free and paid tiers with GPT-4o powering the premium plan.

title: Claude
description:
Anthropic's AI assistant known for nuanced reasoning and long context windows.
Excels at document analysis, coding, and thoughtful conversation.

title: Gemini
description:
Google's multimodal AI integrated across Search, Docs, and Gmail.
Supports text, image, and audio inputs with deep Google ecosystem ties.

title: Midjourney
description:
AI image generator producing stunning, artistic visuals from text prompts.
Favored by designers and creatives for its unique aesthetic quality.

title: GitHub Copilot
description:
AI pair programmer that autocompletes code directly inside your editor.
Powered by OpenAI Codex, supporting dozens of programming languages.

title: Perplexity AI
description:
AI-powered search engine that answers questions with cited web sources.
Combines real-time search with conversational summarization.

title: Notion AI
description:
AI writing and summarization built natively into the Notion workspace.
Helps draft documents, auto-fill tables, and extract action items from notes.

title: Runway ML
description:
Generative AI platform for video creation, editing, and visual effects.
Powers text-to-video, inpainting, and background removal for creators.

title: ElevenLabs
description:
AI voice synthesis platform that clones and generates realistic speech.
Used for audiobooks, dubbing, and AI voiceover in multiple languages.

title: Hugging Face
description:
Open-source hub for thousands of AI models, datasets, and demos.
The go-to platform for researchers and developers to share and deploy ML models.
